TEXTURE Fine Roller.name: TEXTURE Fine Roller
TEXTURE Fine Roller.description: specialized type of paint designed to add depth and dimension to walls and ceilings.
TEXTURE Fine Roller.more_detail:
TEXTURE Fine Roller is a specialized type of paint designed to add depth and dimension to walls and ceilings. Unlike standard flat paint, texture paint has a thicker consistency and often contains coarse materials like sand, Calcium carbonate, or acrylic resins, allowing for a variety of finishes ranging from subtle grainy patterns to dramatic raised designs

Coverage: [10 to 20 square meter/lite]
Finish: Gloss
Drying Time: ≈ [30 min].
Re-coat: ≈ [3 to 4 hours]
Application: using Spray, Brush,Roller
